{{Youmay|the tree|the game [[bannak]]}}
The '''bannak tree''' was a type of large tree that grew on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Volik]]. They grew in the foothills of the world's mountains, and their wood was used by the planet's inhabitants in the construction of buildings.
